verdict.rationale: AuthKit SDK docs cover session management and automatic token refresh: the React SDK handles 'token refresh, and session management', and the Astro SDK offers 'session validation, automatic token refresh'. RBAC docs confirm that sessions are carried as session JWTs. Nothing in the pack shows configurable session expiry or immediate server-side revocation of a compromised session, which is a central part of this story. Missing for 10: documented session expiry configuration, server-side session revocation/logout API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
